title: pl-forecast-bench: a leakage-checked forecasting benchmark for the Polish power system (Zenodo record, v1.1.0)
note: Fetched. Software record v1.1.0 by K. Waleszczynski: day-ahead and intraday (1-6 h) 15-minute forecasts of Polish wind, solar, demand and day-ahead price; fixed data scripts with checksums, as-of rules, 12-month test year (Oct 2025 to Sep 2026), reference models from naive and the PSE plan to ridge, boosting and zero-shot foundation models; leakage tests. Archive holds code and scores, no data.

title: kwwaleszczynski-del/pl-forecast-bench (repository README)
note: Fetched. Day-ahead demand MAE over the test year (MW): PSE plan 414 (published after the 10:00 origin, not ranked), gradient boosting 536, Chronos-2 with NWP covariates 551, Chronos-2 alone 615, Chronos-Bolt 656, ridge 713, Toto 723, TimesFM 2.5 749, weekly naive 1063. Boosting is 29% worse than the plan (95% interval -49 to -13); boosting and Chronos-2 with weather are tied.

title: kwwaleszczynski-del/pl-forecast-bench (repository README)
note: Fetched. Intraday (1-6 h) demand MAE: ridge 331, boosting 353, Chronos-2 with NWP 373, Chronos-2 alone 391, plan 414. Wind day-ahead: univariate foundation models 1250-1290 MW against 468 for Chronos-2 with NWP. Price: Chronos-2 with NWP 88.5 PLN/MWh, 8.8% (3 to 15) better than boosting. 10-90% interval coverage on demand: boosting 59%, Chronos-2 with NWP 72%.

title: kwwaleszczynski-del/pl-forecast-bench (repository README)
note: Fetched. Rules: weather is archived ECMWF IFS runs, visible 7 h after initialisation, never reanalysis. Ridge and boosting get NWP at 8 points, lags and calendar, refitted quarterly; foundation models are zero-shot on 1,024 hourly means day-ahead, Chronos-2 also with the variable's NWP index and temperature. Code MIT; weights Apache-2.0 by the model cards.

title: kwwaleszczynski-del/pl-forecast-bench (repository README)
note: Fetched. Stated limits: national aggregates, one weather model, one test year, final republished actuals stand in for real-time values (unquantified help to intraday models), simplified settlement, real-data leakage tests not run in CI. One model variant was chosen on the validation split. 0 stars, 0 forks, 6 commits.

title: PL Forecast Bench (leaderboard site)
note: Fetched. Agrees with the README: day-ahead demand best as-of model is gradient boosting, 536 MW, -29.4% against the PSE plan; intraday demand ridge 331 MW, +20.1%. The plan is a reference marked not as-of. Monthly hindcast: no months scored, the job is off. Only the wind tab's full table came through in the fetch.

title: pl-forecast-bench docs/pairwise.json
note: Fetched. Pairwise skill, 95% block-bootstrap intervals. Day-ahead demand: boosting against Chronos-2 with NWP 2.8% (-13.2 to +14.4), no winner; boosting against rescaled plan -31.3% (-49.7 to -16.1). Intraday demand: ridge against boosting 6.3% (-0.6 to +13.8). Wind: Chronos-2 with NWP against without 62.6% (59.5 to 65.3). No with-against-without pair for demand.

title: pl-forecast-bench benchmark/spec.toml
note: Fetched. The frozen definition, version 1.0: train 21 Jun 2024 to 30 Jun 2025, validation Jul to Sep 2025, test 1 Oct 2025 to 30 Sep 2026; day-ahead issue 10:00 local on D-1; intraday hourly origins, leads 60 to 345 min; nine deciles; observation lag 60 min, NWP delay 7 h. A config file in the repository, not an external registration.

title: Release pl-forecast-bench 1.1.0
note: Fetched (also a research source). Release of 30 Oct 2026 at commit 91cd1ae, the first archived release: frozen benchmark v1, reference models with test-year scores including Toto, leakage tests, monthly track off by default.
